title: Localization of weakly convergent integer multiplicity cycles to a good sublevel set of dist(·, W̄)
statement: Assume (SL) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_slicing_lipschitz (a dependency of the parent node), taken as an antecedent: assuming (C1), for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ), every IMRep RB = (M', θ', ξ') representing ∂T and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are P_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) such that (1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from f⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K. X_j ⇀ Y (WeaklyConvergesOn) means X_j(ω) → Y(ω) for every ω. V ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained V U) means that closure V is compact and contained in U. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and let T_j (j ∈ ℕ) and T be IM currents in 𝒟_n(U) with ∂T_j = 0 for every j, sup_j M_V(T_j) < ∞ for every open V ⊂⊂ U, and T_j ⇀ T in U. Let W ⊆ ℝ^P be nonempty with W ⊂⊂ U. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, a compact K ⊆ U, Λ ∈ [0, ∞) and currents T'_j (j ∈ ℕ), T' ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that: every T'_j, every ∂T'_j and T' are IM; every T'_j vanishes off K; M(T'_j) ≤ Λ and M(∂T'_j) ≤ Λ for every j; T'_j ⇀ T' in U; and T'_j(ω) = T_{φ(j)}(ω) and T'(ω) = T(ω) for every j and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. (In the proof, T'_j = T_{φ(j)}⌞{dist(·, W̄) < t} and T' = T⌞{dist(·, W̄) < t} for a well chosen level t; this is step 1 of the parent proof, Simon Ch. 6, proof of 7.2, 'by 4.5(1),(2) and an argument as in 6.7(2) of Ch. 2'.)
lean_statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ j, (Ts j).boundary = 0) → (∀ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V → CompactlyContained V U → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn V < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → W.Nonempty → CompactlyContained W U → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) (Ts' : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), StrictMono φ ∧ IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ Λ ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts' j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts' j).boundary) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity T' ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → Ts' j ω = 0) ∧ (∀ j, (Ts' j).mass ≤ Λ ∧ (Ts' j).boundary.mass ≤ Λ) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn Ts' T' ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ W → Ts' j ω = Ts (φ j) ω) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ W → T' ω = T ω
